name: ECGDA_Benchmark
description: Benchmark for evaluating ECG data augmentation methods and their impact on downstream ECG classification and detection tasks. It measures how different augmentation strategies affect model performance on arrhythmia/ECG classification benchmarks and robustness metrics. Designed for researchers developing data-centric and augmentation techniques for medical time-series.
reputation: A specialized research benchmark with limited but growing use in ECG/medical ML communities.
